MatchFilterDict.name: match_filter_dict
MatchFilterDict.description: JSON object, e.g. {"site_code":"dtcafe"}. It is AND-ed with the caller's access filter. A value that is not valid JSON is ignored, and the list comes back unfiltered.

SortDict.name: sort_dict
SortDict.description: JSON sort, e.g. {"product_name":1}. An unreadable value uses the default order.

IdsList.name: ids_list
IdsList.description: JSON array of ids. Narrows the filter to those rows.

GetCount.name: get_count
GetCount.description: On page 1, `true` returns `total_count` and no rows. On later pages it changes nothing.

ListId.name: list_id
ListId.description: A saved list to apply, by its static ids or its filter.

PageSize.name: page_size
PageSize.description: Rows per page. Above 500 is treated as 500.

Envelope.description: The platform envelope. HTTP 200 for success and refusals; branch on `result`.

error_code.description:
Present when `result` is 2. Stable, safe to branch on. `INVENTORY_READ_FAILED`
means the read failed. It is never sent for an empty result.

status_code.description: On an error. 200, except 500 on INVENTORY_REQUIRES_PRO. The HTTP status is 200 in both cases.

data.description:
On a refusal that names what was refused, an OBJECT. Place refusals carry
`site_code`, `location_code`, `bin_code`; `INVENTORY_PLACE_HAS_STOCK` and
`INVENTORY_BINS_REQUIRED_HAS_UNBINNED_STOCK` add `qty_on_hand` and
`position_count`. On a success from most report and picklist routes under
`/user/inventory/`, an ARRAY.

InventoryTxn.description: One movement. There is no route to edit or delete it.

txn_type_code.description: The named type, e.g. `misc_issue` (Issue), `waste_issue` (Wasted), `cost_update`. Group on this to separate waste from other issues.

created_ts.description: When the row was written (epoch seconds).

qty.description: Signed for single-place movements (an issue is negative). A transfer carries the positive quantity moved; its source moved by minus that. A count posting carries the variance; a write-down and a cost update carry 0.

unit_cost.description: On a cost update, the new cost.

total_value.description: On a write-down or cost update, the size of the value change.

books_entity_id.description: The Books company. On a transfer, the destination company.

is_intercompany.description: Transfer only. True when the two ends belong to different companies.

writedown_account_id.description: Snapshotted. Where a write-down or cost update posts; blank means expense_account_id.

waste_account_id.description: Snapshotted. Where a Wasted issue posts; blank means expense_account_id.

grni_account_id.description: Snapshotted. Where a receipt against a purchase order is credited.

metadata.description: On a cost update: `cost_update_id` (the request's client_txn_id), `automatic` (true for a standard cost edit), `cost_basis_before`, `cost_basis_after`.

balance_after.description: Legacy; the destination on a transfer.

lot_number.description: Set when the movement touched exactly one lot.

reference.description: On a goods receipt's transaction, the receipt number.

source_line_id.description: The purchase order line a goods receipt transaction satisfied. Empty on older rows.

goods_receipt_id.description: The goods receipt that wrote it. Empty on older rows.

goods_receipt_line_id.description: The receipt line that wrote it. Empty on older rows.

po_number.description: With the three above: "Purchase order {po_number}, line {po_line_number}".

over_receipt_tolerance_pct.description:
How far past the ordered quantity one purchase order line may be
received, across all its posted goods receipts. 10 means up to 110%
of the order. Stored on the tenant as `inventory_settings`.

InventoryItem.description: A **balance** — one product at one place. Not the product itself.

qty_on_hand.description: Never directly writable. Moves only via a movement or a posted count.

unit_cost.description: Computed at read time from the average, last receipt or standard cost.

stock_value.description: Stored copy of the value, for aggregations.

cost_basis.description: Blank in list and detail reads of a row created by `POST /user/inventory_item` that has never moved. Create and update responses show the computed basis.

days_of_cover_known.description: `false` means unknown, which is not the same as zero cover.

earliest_expiry_date.description: Epoch seconds of the oldest lot's expiry.

updated_by_userid.description: Who last changed the row. Movements, transfers, write-downs, cost updates and a consumption estimate all stamp it.

lead_time_days.description: Decimals are cut, so 2.9 is saved as 2. A value that is not a number is saved as 0.

shelf_life_days.description: Decimals are cut, so 2.9 is saved as 2. A value that is not a number is saved as 0.

valuation_method.description: Blank is saved as `weighted_average`. `fifo`, `standard` and unknown methods are refused with `INVENTORY_VALUATION_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE`.

standard_cost.description:
The estimated cost per unit of this stock line, 0 or more. A line
with no receipt cost (no average, no last receipt, not written
down) is valued at it, so changing it on such a line writes a
`cost_update` movement (reason `Estimated cost changed`) in the
same ledger write. A line on average or receipt cost stores the
number and its value does not change. If the movement cannot be
written the whole edit is refused (`INVENTORY_BALANCE_BUSY` and
the other balance-write refusals) and nothing is saved. Null or
`""` is saved as 0.

site_code.description: Blank uses the creator's sole registered OAG site, or no site.

books_entity_id.description: The Books company. Blank uses the site's company.

txn_type_code.description: A named type from `GET /user/inventory/txn_type`. Decides `txn_type` and the source. `waste_issue` (Wasted) needs `reason` or `reason_code`.

reason.description: Free text. `adjustment`, `count` and `waste_issue` need this or `reason_code`.

location_code.description: Blank is the site's main area. Must be registered when nonblank.

bin_code.description: Must be registered at the location when nonblank; required when the location has `bins_required`.

qty.description: Signed for `adjustment` and `count`, where the sign is the direction. Other types use the magnitude. Rounded to the product's precision.

uom.description: The unit you are sending. Blank is the stocking unit. If it differs from the stocking unit, quantity AND unit cost are converted together.

unit_cost.description: A RATE in `uom`, not an extended amount. Read only on `receipt` and `wip_receipt`, where it moves the weighted average. Every other type drops it and uses the position's average or standard cost.

txn_ts.description: When the movement happened, in epoch seconds. Defaults to now. Send seconds: there is no range check, so milliseconds give a far-future date. A string such as an ISO date is read as now.

client_txn_id.description: **Idempotency key.** A repeat returns the original movement with `duplicate: true`.

books_entity_id.description: The Books company, as digits. Blank uses the site's company.

secondary_qty.description: Catch-weight items: the weight moved. Send a number. A value that is not a number is saved as 0.

lot_number.description: Tracked products: the lot or serial number for a receipt without `lot_lines`. A serial receipt this way must have `qty` 1.

lot_lines.description: Tracked products: one entry per lot, `{lot_number, qty, expiry_date}`. Quantities must add up to `qty`. On a serial receipt each entry counts as 1, whatever `qty` it sends. On stock going out, names the lots to take from.

scanned_code.description: A scanned label. Its lot, serial and expiry are used when not sent.

expiry_date.description: Tracked products: the lot expiry for a receipt. `YYYY-MM-DD`, or a JSON number of epoch seconds. A number such as `20300131` is refused with `INVENTORY_LOT_DATE_INVALID`. Send this, not `expiry_ts`. An `expiry_ts` integer is taken as is, with no range check.

to_site_code.description: For `transfer`. Defaults to the source site.

to_location_code.description: For `transfer`. Blank is the main area.

include_zero_qty.description: Send a JSON boolean. Only `false` turns it off; `"false"` and `0` count as true.

count_date.description: Defaults to today in the tenant's time zone.

week_start_day.description: Used to compute the period. It is not stored on the session.

count_ts.description: Epoch seconds. Defaults to now. Send seconds: milliseconds give a far-future date, and an ISO date string is read as now.

books_entity_id.description: The Books company, as digits. Blank uses the site's company.
